gloss: by all means, at any cost

definitions.gloss: by all means, without fail, at any cost
definitions.explanation: An emphatic form of ぜひ, expressing a strong desire or request. Conveys that the speaker is very earnest about wanting something to happen.

examples.japanese: {是非|ぜひ}ともお{越|こ}しください。
examples.english: Please do come, by all means.

examples.japanese: {是非|ぜひ}とも{成功|せいこう}させたい。
examples.english: I want to make it succeed at any cost.

examples.japanese: この{機会|きかい}を{是非|ぜひ}とも{活|い}かしていただきたいと{思|おも}います。
examples.english: I very much hope you will make the most of this opportunity.

notes:
USAGE NOTES:
{是非|ぜひ}とも is a stronger, more emphatic version of {是非|ぜひ} ("by all means, definitely"). It adds extra urgency or earnestness to requests and wishes. Often used in formal or polite contexts to show sincerity.

COMPARISON WITH {是非|ぜひ}:
- {是非|ぜひ}{来|き}てください: Please come. (polite request)
- {是非|ぜひ}とも{来|き}てください: Please do come, by all means. (more emphatic)

REGISTER:
Slightly more formal than {是非|ぜひ} alone. Common in business settings and formal invitations.
